New features: The calendar now has separate Upcoming and Past tabs, so you can look back at what's already released or aired, not just what's coming next
Your watchlist can now be filtered to just Movies or just TV Shows, and shows richer info at a glance - genres, release year (or full year range for ongoing shows), and posters
The forced update screen now shows friendlier, easier-to-read notes about what's new
Performance & stability: Fixed a bug where the calendar's "today" releases could be dropped or shown a day off due to timezone handling
Fixed a bug where opening a movie/show detail screen could unexpectedly scroll the page behind it to the bottom
Watchlist items now keep their genre, runtime, and streaming info up to date automatically when added
